package.description: A standalone markdown viewer for Windows with syntax highlighting and diagram support.

en-US.description: A standalone markdown viewer for Windows with syntax highlighting and diagram support.
en-US.longDescription:
mdmdview is a single-binary markdown viewer for Windows built with Rust and egui.
Features include syntax highlighting, Mermaid/Pikchr/D2 diagram rendering,
emoji support, keyboard-driven navigation, and a built-in editor.
en-US.name: mdmdview
